worldcombat.skill.sheercold.summary: Drop the air around the target to absolute zero: a ring of frost spreads out, the nearest up to four non-Ice foes inside are chilled, and a harmless frost glow remains on the ground. Ice users freeze it faster; it is no longer an instant kill.
Mark a real 3D cold zone centred on the ground under the target, freeze radius %1$s blocks. At the freeze, the nearest up to 4 non-Ice targets inside each take %2$s fixed damage (400 total cap). Native immunity and damage rules still apply.

There are %1$s s between locking the ring and the freeze; an Ice-type user shortens it sharply, each level above the target shortens it further, and a higher-level target drags it out - those inside must step out in that time.
A low-brightness frost sheet stays on the ground for %1$s s; it deals no damage and changes no blocks.
worldcombat.skill.sheercold.glacial.on: Glacial form: freeze radius x1.2 and a longer-lived frost, at the cost of +7 ticks of freeze delay and +10 cooldown - a larger, longer-lasting ring with a slower warning.
worldcombat.skill.sheercold.glacial.off: Flash form: freezes sooner and recharges faster, but a smaller ring and a shorter frost.
worldcombat.skill.sheercold.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.sheercold.growth.0: From level %1$s the freeze radius reaches %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.sheercold.growth.1: From level %1$s the freeze radius reaches %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.sheercold.use.0: Chill several foes in one ring around the target
worldcombat.skill.sheercold.use.1: Let an Ice-type user steal a much shorter window
worldcombat.skill.sheercold.use.2: Leave a harmless short-lived frost sheet that marks the frozen zone
worldcombat.skill.sheercold.preference.g: On: freeze radius x1.2 and frost x1.3 longer, at the cost of +7 ticks of freeze delay and +10 cooldown - a larger ring with a slower warning. Off (flash form): freezes sooner and recharges faster, but a smaller ring and a shorter frost.
worldcombat.skill.sheercold.preference.a: The companion only considers sheer cold while the threat is within this distance; smaller keeps it close, larger closes into the radius from further away.
Casts only with at least this many visible, non-Ice enemies inside the zone centred on the chosen landing point; larger saves it for being surrounded, 1 freezes a single foe.
